free_run_induction.kind: logical induction backed by a direct 10-token production-loop smoke
assumptions: greedy decoding is deterministic and sampling is disabled
prefill stays on the unchanged CPU/F32 path and selects token 9419
the body candidate starts from the same prefill state
at teacher step n, the forced input is exactly the native CPU token selected at step n-1
the teacher gate advances the candidate's own quantized recurrent/KV state at every step
free_run_induction.argument: The candidate and CPU choose the same next token at each of 128 consecutive decode steps. Therefore the token selected at step n is exactly the forced input used at step n+1. By induction, a no-EOS greedy free run follows the same candidate state and token path for the initial prefill token plus all 128 tested decode outputs.
not_claimed: quality or correctness for any multi-layer body set

twenty_four_layer_first_order_estimate.decision: The arithmetic estimate narrowly clears the 5% threshold, so an all-layer diagnostic correctness experiment is allowed. It is not a performance admission.

performance_screen.qualification: Unarchived candidate primitive screen plus a contaminated historical whole-token baseline; the estimate assumes 24 independent identical savings. The host was noisy and no formal end-to-end ABBA was run.

admission.reason: Token selection gates pass for the tested layer and prompt, but the frozen F32 logits and state envelopes fail by large margins.
